description: Take a snapshot of a VPS before doing something risky. Cheap and fast, and it is what makes a rollback possible later — offer it whenever the customer is about to upgrade, migrate or change something they cannot easily undo.

description.description: Optional note about why the snapshot was taken.

name.description: Short snapshot name, e.g. before-php84. Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore only.
